model.name: Sex-Specific Binomial Logistic Regression
model.formula: logit(p) = beta_0 + beta_female * log(female_gametocytes_per_ul) + beta_male * log(male_gametocytes_per_ul)

diagnostics.model_comparison: Sex-specific model significantly outperforms total-gametocyte model (LRT chi2=13.76, df=1, p=2.08e-04; AIC 778.5 vs 790.3). Both female (beta=0.878, p<0.001) and male (beta=0.547, p<0.001) densities independently predict mosquito infection.
diagnostics.asexual_assessment: Asexual parasite density adds no useful predictive information after controlling for sex-specific gametocyte densities (LRT chi2=0.56, df=1, p=0.45; AIC increases to 779.9). Asexual parasitemia is an upstream correlate of gametocytogenesis rather than a direct transmission determinant.
diagnostics.calibration: Goodness-of-fit deviance test indicates no significant lack of fit (deviance=15.55 on 24 d.f., p=0.9037). Pearson chi-squared (14.81, p=0.926) confirms good model calibration with no overdispersion.

literature.claim: Pfs25 qRT-PCR specifically quantifies female Plasmodium falciparum gametocytes while PfMGET qRT-PCR quantifies male gametocytes, enabling accurate sex-specific gametocyte measurement.
literature.citation: Meerstein-Kessel L, et al. A multiplex assay for the sensitive detection and quantification of male and female Plasmodium falciparum gametocytes. Malaria Journal. 2018.

literature.claim: Gametocyte density measured by sex-specific qRT-PCR (Pfs25 and PfMGET) directly predicts mosquito infection rates in feeding assays, while SBP1 qRT-PCR measures asexual parasite stages.
literature.citation: Bradley J, et al. Plasmodium falciparum Gametocyte Density and Infectivity in Peripheral Blood and Skin Tissue of Naturally Infected Parasite Carriers in Burkina Faso. Clinical Infectious Diseases. 2021.

literature.claim: Mosquito infection success requires viable male and female gametocytes for fertilization in the mosquito midgut; total gametocyte counts mask critical sex-ratio dynamics.
literature.citation: Bradley J, et al. Higher gametocyte production and mosquito infectivity in chronic malaria infections. Nature Communications. 2021.
